title: Shared linear KV transport with dev-selected sparse private nonlinear repair
hypothesis: A pooled per-role affine KV translator plus small pair-specific gain/bias coordinates will handle at least one of two calibrated Pythia-to-SmolLM2 pairs; a private per-role nonlinear residual, enabled only for pairs marked hard on development (shared-view delta to native >1.0 nat), will repair those pairs within the independent ridge quality while keeping private state ≤20% and total payload ≤75% of the independent two-pair ridge bank.
prior_art_boundary: PA236 establishes closed-form cross-model ridge and layer matching; PA238 motivates nonlinear translators and target-context correction. This component screen uses ordinary unweighted ridge and a residual MLP; it is not a CacheBridge or MoT reproduction.
physical_object: One shared affine KV map per target layer/head/KV role, pooled across two source-model pairs.
logical_multiplicity: Per-pair translator views from output gain/bias coordinates; fixed pair-ID repair mask enables private nonlinear state only for development-identified hard pairs.
mirror_coordinate: Pair/role FiLM gain and bias over a shared map; optional private per-role residual MLP for the frozen hard-pair mask. FiLM and low-rank identity-activation controls are ordinary native methods and are not Mirror-specific.

data.old_content_exclusion: Exclude all top-level article titles and exact normalized text rows appearing in any Wikitext-2 raw-v1 train/validation/test split.
data.article_partition: Assign whole top-level articles by int(SHA256(title)[:8],16) mod 4: bucket 0 development; buckets 1/2/3 fresh seeds 983/997/1009.
data.pairing: Use the same text rows for both source-target pairs; require exact source/target tokenizer offset equality for both pairs.
data.eligibility: 16-128 tokens; exact character-offset equality; unique text; title absent from Wikitext-2.
data.fresh_claim_boundary: Article-heldout Wikitext-103-train audit, not standard Wikitext-103 validation/test benchmark.

fixed_design.layer_alignment: nearest relative depth; fixed across all methods
fixed_design.rope: inverse source RoPE before fitting and target RoPE after key translation
fixed_design.roles: 180 SmolLM2 roles: 30 target layers × 3 KV heads × key/value
fixed_design.shared_base: Pooled affine ridge sufficient statistics from both source pairs on development map-fit prompts; frozen for fresh evaluation.
fixed_design.pair_view: Per-role scalar output gain plus 64D bias, fit by closed-form least squares from calibration prompts.
fixed_design.hard_pair_rule: Freeze pair-ID repair mask from development check prompts: mark a pair hard when pair-FiLM next-token NLL minus native target NLL >1.0 nat. Repair at most one of two pairs for a sparse-exception claim; if both are hard, retain both and declare sparse premise failed.
fixed_design.repair: Pair-private per-role 64→h→64 GELU residual MLP over normalized source KV content; charge all weights, biases, input/residual normalization means and scales.
fixed_design.optimizer: Adam, lr=0.001, 24 fixed updates per pair/view; deterministic initialization from recorded seed; zero-initialized output layer.
fixed_design.objective: Normalized rolewise KV residual MSE +0.10 target replay next-token cross-entropy; target model weights frozen.
fixed_design.linear_residual_control: Same per-role two-layer residual parameterization, width, initialization, data, updates, and objective with identity activation instead of GELU.

development.selection: Freeze hard-pair mask by the stated >1.0 nat check rule. Select the smallest hidden width among 4/8/16 whose repair NLL minimizes the flagged-pair development test mean; ties to smaller width. If no pair is flagged, freeze h=4 and record no repair selection evidence.

fresh.selection: Prompt rows and hard-pair mask are fixed before fresh outcomes; all pairs are reported even if not repaired.
fresh.runtime_gate: Static pair-ID repair mask only. No target-NLL runtime oracle or post-fresh pair selection.

controls: Native target prefill and native-cache replay identity
Independent full affine ridge maps per pair
Shared pooled affine ridge without pair code
Shared map plus pair/role FiLM gain and bias, no private repair
Frozen-mask shared FiLM plus private identity-activation low-rank residual
Frozen-mask shared FiLM plus private GELU residual MLP
Independent full ridge plus nonlinear residual MLP for both pairs as upper control
success_gate: In every fresh pair×seed condition, sparse nonlinear candidate is within +0.50 nat of full ridge and +1.00 nat of native. For each repaired pair it improves ≥0.50 nat over shared FiLM and is within +0.25 nat of the independent nonlinear upper control; it beats the identity-activation control by ≥0.10 nat at matched width. Private repair bytes ≤20% and total shared+codes+private bytes ≤75% of the independent two-pair ridge payload, and no more than 1/2 pairs are repaired.
failure_gate: Any quality, byte, nonlinear-attribution, or sparse-mask gate fails with prompt and serialization integrity passing. Report shared-linear failure, repair improvement, and byte exhaustion separately.

upper_control_paid_state: independent full maps plus every per-pair nonlinear residual state
storage.common_model_weights: reported separately and excluded from marginal translator payload

serialization_integrity.format: MA883 versioned little-endian float32 inference payloads with explicit pair and repair masks
serialization_integrity.roundtrip: Deserialize every method payload and replay the same fixed target prompts; require per-condition NLL absolute difference <=0.001 nat and exact parameter tensor reconstruction.
serialization_integrity.payload_hash: SHA-256 each complete serialized inference payload; report actual file length in bytes.
serialization_integrity.scope: All bases, pair coordinates, maps, repair weights, normalization state, metadata, and masks needed for deterministic reconstruction are paid in the relevant payload.

report: cache-apply and target replay wall time

scope: Two ordered Pythia-to-SmolLM2 pairs, one-token replay NLL, article-heldout Wikitext-103-train text.
Static pair-level repair only; no runtime confidence gate.
No broad unseen-model-pair generalization or Mirror-specific claim from FiLM/MLP utility.
protocol_amendments: Before development: specified serialized-payload deserialization and replay checks as a required integrity gate; implementation only, no method or metric change.
